title: Misremembered union official Charley Williamson, Ernie Williamson or Ernie Lewis
summary: Fields and Love try to work out the name of the national union officer who led a tempo band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I did it at the convention with-- what's his name?
Yeah; the piano player, who used to be our vice.
Yeah, you know, he used to come to your house you were saying, this piano player.
Yeah, he's one of the national officials.
He usually has a tempo band. It's Ernie Williamson, isn't it? He used to be the travelling delegate from National when we had the black local and everything.
He used to stay with Basie Gibbons when he came here.
